name: Lead Research for Action
summary: Runs research on sources of lead exposure in low- and middle-income countries so that governments and others can act to reduce childhood lead poisoning.

spending.source: https://web.archive.org/web/20260612133826/https://www.charityentrepreneurship.com/track-record-charities/lead-research-for-action (no published accounts: its US money runs through a fiscal sponsor, Players Philanthropy Fund, and its UK charity no. 1218900 was registered in July 2026. A $264,000 seed grant at its start in October 2024; charityevals' judgment of about $600,000 spent from October 2024 to October 2026, about $300,000 a year, is in lead-research-for-action-charityevals' spend_total)

lines.label: Market studies of lead in consumer products and recommendations (Malawi; Kenya and a further country under way)
lines.source: https://www.leadresearch.org/research (one programme; no accounts split it, so the whole judged yearly spending is one line)
